findings.summary: Declared maintenance failure paths are not reachable through the typed capability or workflow contracts.
findings.details: Pure helpers throw MaintenancePolicyError names, but neither the Confect capability implementation nor the workflow contract maps those names to the declared typed errors. The workflow spec exposes only generic workflow failures. Consumers therefore cannot rely on CitationRequired, CitationNotInManifest, RevisionBudgetExceeded, AutopilotNotEligible, StaleRevision, or LifecycleRevoked at the typed contract boundary.
